notes.title: Episode 5 is now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Choose your romance path[/b]
Will Sara be able to figure out where her heart lies? While Gabe is fine, Thomas continues to flirt with her, and things are going well for them. Will she be able to choose one of them in the end? And what about Lily's relationship with her? Is she prepared to risk it all as well?

[b]New story focus[/b]
These final episodes will contain a more in-depth look at Sara's life and interpersonal connections. A murder case will be introduced in Episode 5, which will reappear in the season finale as her personal decision takes center stage.

[b]Episodic Release[/b]
This episode is the fifth of 6.
The game's replayability gives you the chance to start over and face completely new situations.
The Coroner Saga is an episodic Visual Novel which will have you deal with Sara's personal and professional life as well. Meet new people, interact with colleagues and fellow doctors and uncover the truth behind several murder cases throughout the game's season.

[b]Medical accuracy[/b]
Developed with the help of a real MD, the game features medical informations that are accurate and up-to-date. Please do not take medical informations other than for having fun in the game. If you experience some medical concern ask your doctor as soon as possible.

[b]Original Soundtrack[/b]
New scores have been added to the soundtrack to involve you more and more into the game's situations.


[b]PLAYERS WHO ALREADY OWN THE "FULL SEASON 1" DLC DO NOT NEED TO BUY THIS GAME AS WELL![/b]

notes.title: Episode 5 will dwelve deeper in Sara's personal life
notes.notes:
While Sara investigates on different murder cases, this episode will focus more on her life and relationships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34256680/96c0411462e910b525968507a2c08c63edb572b9.png[/img]

I decided to change the tone of the episode because I want to focus more on Sara's personal life.

The original idea was to make the player explore Sara's relationships with Gabe, Thomas and Lily.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34256680/7f47aacdbe4ba3ef6572213cc6e676745d4ff557.jpg[/img]

I think it would be interesting if the player could see how she works under pressure and how her personal life is connected with her job.


Sara's character will be more fleshed out and the player will get a chance to understand her better. There will also be new cases for the player to solve, as well as some familiar faces from previous episodes. Choices will be few but meaningful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34256680/a8d34ae5eb112dd6060ba75d39881157b21b1f5d.jpg[/img]

You can expect around 5-6 hours of gameplay.

I really hope you enjoy this episode, which will set the stage for the season's conclusion!

Thank you,

Episode 5 will pick up where the last one left off, with protagonist Sarah Brennan investigating the mysterious deaths of five people whose bodies were found full of cuts and bruises.

You will also engage deeper in Sara's personal life as Gabriel, Thomas and Lily will  appear more often to provide emotional support during the case.

notes.title: Happy new year!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all players and community!

This has been an unique year. And I sincerely hope it stays that way.

Many of my projects have suffered a serious delay, both for [b]personal family issues[/b] which I already told you about in the last few months and that are far from being over, and for [b]economical reasons[/b], of course.  The plan to launch a brand-new [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] in November was halted, as the world and people are still struggling with the pandemic and its effects on our lives.

Development for my games hasn't stopped a bit, but it was delayed as I had to take care of my children and family, especially while schools were closed and they had to stay home. I managed to release many updates and new stories, and in the next few months more will come with[b] a new Otome Visual Novel[/b], new chapters for [b]The Devil's Shoes[/b], improvements on [b]Yomi Alliance[/b], the [b]2nd free DLC for General Practitioner[/b] and[b] two new episodes of The Coroner Saga[/b], which are already written and only need some polish.

New rewards are also available for Patrons on my [url=https://patreon.com/brunimultimedia]Patreon page[/url], and they will keep getting released over and over. I think that would be the best way to thank you for your support, despite my setbacks which are not due to my will but which I apologize for, regardless.

[b]Developing a videogame, even a Visual Novel, is a very costly effort[/b], and you only see results months after you spend those money. For a single-man company like mine this is more than a challenge at times, and that's why [b]I completely rely on your support[/b] and your appreciation of my work to keep doing what I do: develop games to entertain you in the best of times, and in the worst of times.

[b]So, thank you for your support, past, present and future. Without you, there won't be any Bruni Multimedia to talk about and no videogames at all from me.[/b]

I hope you can live a happier year, we're going through this together, as the Doctor told during the "Coronavirus Exam" released last February (my, it's already a full year!).

Happy new year to everyone. Keep following me, because there will be tons of news coming up in the next few days

Stay safe, and healthy!

notes.title: The current COVID-19 situation and our games
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's very strange to write this stuff, but I think you deserve to know the behind-the-scenes of the current situation in Italy, the place where I live and work.

The lockdown announced by the government fortunately doesn't include my job, so I can keep developing all my games (as you can see by the updates I published yesterday and the day before).

However, it would be false to state that it doesn't affect my production at all. The streets are empty as they are on holiday weeks, right now I can still access my office but I don't know for how long (I can still work from home, but it would be VERY difficult), plus I'm overall concerned for my family and kids, and writing videogames with that kind of mental stress is sometimes difficult. But I'm trying to do my best, as I always did. And I just hope the situation won't be worse than this in the future.

Plus, with most services out of order and the invitation to go out by oneself and without other family members, I have to take care of many things personally, which is something that takes time and it's a time I can't work at all (buying groceries, bills, managing bank accounts, buying medicines and playing with my kids since the schools are closed).

So, some updates of the game could be delivered with a delay in the near future. I am VERY sorry about this and believe me I'm doing the best I can to ensure you'll receive everything smoothly as I always did in the last three years (BTW, the 3-year anniversary for General Practitioner is coming on May and there will be surprises for everyone!)

That's it. I just wanted you to know the current situation and why I'm more silent than ever on social media channels: right now all my energies are focused on developing stories, not talking about them.

Thank you for your support. I hope this situation will defuse soon and without long-lasting consequences. BTW for those of you who still don't know I published a "Coronavirus Update" on General Practitioner a while ago. It's not meant to inform people about the situation, it's just meant to smile and be a "doctor Casanova" despite everything :)

Be safe and healthy, now more than ever!

ANDREA BRUNI

notes.title: Character Bios: Sara Brennan
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34256680/0e3fd9c66d5ff905762ef2fe022604f902c7e5e5.jpg[/img]

[b]Name[/b]: Sara Aveline Brennan
[b]Date of birth[/b]: October 19th, 32 years old
[b]Blood type[/b]: A

Sara Aveline Brennan is the main character of The Coroner Saga. She graduated a few years back with the highest degrees and has since then worked here and there without staying too much in the same place.

Sensitive and stubborn, she always felt out of place around medical institutions throughout the country, until she finally knew that her future would've been shaped around dead people. An accident (well, more an homicide in fact) occurred to a friend of her grandmother when she was still a student was solved years later thanks to Sara's help, and the sense of justice she felt made it absolutely clear she wanted to avenge the innocents' violent deaths by uncovering the truth behind them.

While most coroners are professionally detached from the decedants they work with, Sara's sensitive character makes her drown into their families' emotions and grief and this spurs her even more in her job.

Coming from a caring and loving family, Sara grew emotionally balanced. She is still looking for her soulmate despite not having much time between her work and her studies to actually find it properly. She doesn't care about genders as well, as long as her partner is caring, funny and adventorous. 
Make her laugh and you'll know you're on the right path to win her heart.

notes.title: Announcing "The Coroner Saga - An Otome episodic Visual Novel" and more...
notes.notes:
Greetings guys!

As promised today I want to share some big news with you: the upcoming release of a new Bruni Multimedia project - [b]The Coroner Saga[/b]. This is a separate project from General Practitioner, a different team of few but very dedicated people are actually working on it so this isn't going to change the scheduled release of General Practitioner in any way (by the way, you can take a look at the game's roadmap here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/936960/announcements/detail/1701693602812076371

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33586573/fdf7837015cd518b8b5c3cd9a4754d960089f086.jpg[/img]

[b]What is The Coroner Saga (TCS)?[/b] It's an otome Visual Novel, a smaller project compared to General Practitioner and an episodic-release one as well. Each "Season" of TCS will be made of 6 episodes, each varying in gameplay lenght of about 5-6 hours and with many different romance options and endings.

It is also a very interesting and well written story, having award-winner author JD Glass as Lead Writer for the project (someone might recognize her from her work on Voltage Entertainment's Visual Novels as well as many other works).

The Visual Novel will also be available on Japanese with fully-translated interface and game. Other translations will be available if there's enough interest in the project as well. As for General Practitioner, a Patreon crowdfunding is also established for TCS with specific rewards for pledgers, and if a certain goal is met translations will be implemented for TCS.

The Coroner Saga features:

[list]
[*] An original Otome Visual Novel written by award winner JD Glass
[*] Adult gameplay with realistic sexual situations and medical-related nudity
[*] Full HD graphics (1920x1080)
[*] 6 six-hour-long episodes for Season 1
[*] Different choices and routes will bring you to different outcome in the story, changing not only the single episode but the whole season's experience.
[*] Real medical content and scenarios written in collaboration with a real medical doctor who already worked to our Early Access Visual Novel General Practitioner
[*] 6 different murder cases to solve. Each case will have you work in a simulation-minigame to find the correct clues.
[*] Choose your gameplay: Vanilla for the game without adult content or “Story” for the complete experience
[*] Original 10-tracks Soundtrack
[*] Stunning user interface developed by Graphic Designer Laura "Sasquatchii" Henderson
[*] Full Japanese Translation
[*] Available for PC, MAC, Linux (Android Devices in Q4 2019 as well)
[/list]

There's a news about our website as well: take a look to discover what has changed and explore the two new websites we made to keep each project separated:

[list]
[*] New Bruni Multimedia Website ([url=www.brunimultimedia.com]www.brunimultimedia.com[/url])
[*] General Practitioner dedicated website ([url=www.generalpractitionergame.com]www.generalpractitionergame.com[/url])
[*] The Coroner Saga dedicated website ([url=www.thecoronersaga.com]www.thecoronersaga.com[/url])
[/list]

The game is already on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010260/The_Coroner_Saga/]Steam Store page[/url]: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010260/The_Coroner_Saga/

It won't be released as an Early Access game, it will be a full release right from the beginning. Release date is set for April but more informations will be released in the upcoming weeks.

If you wish to start supporting the project and you liked our work on General Practitioner [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010260/The_Coroner_Saga/]add The Coroner Saga to your wishlist[/url]!

Thank you for following us and our projects, we are very proud of our small but dedicated fan community and we wish you to always be safe and healthy!

PS: exciting news for General Practitioner are coming as well in a few hours: stay tuned!
